subtasks.title: Backend: expose vehicle_year/make/model/hotlist_us_state in Scout day()/show() hits_detail + bump cache key
subtasks.approach: In ClarityScoutTripsController, expand the hits_cold .select([...]) in both day() and show() to add vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, hotlist_us_state. Map those into the hits_detail payload items alongside the existing ocr/hit_created_at/hit_type/lat/lng/scan_guid fields (nullable-safe). Bump the response cache key (append :v2 to scanner:day:{orgId}:{kitId}:{date} and the scanner:trip key) so post-deploy reads don't return stale cached payloads missing the new fields. No schema/migration work (fields already exist in hits_cold). Then extend the controller test: have insertHitCold()/insertHitHot() helpers populate the four new columns and assert hits_detail items carry them (nullable-aware) plus hit_type.
subtasks.intended_diffs: ClarityScoutTripsController.php day() (~line 295): add 'vehicle_year','vehicle_make','vehicle_model','hotlist_us_state' to the hits_cold .select([...]); in the hits_detail mapping (~lines 350-361) add vehicle_year/vehicle_make/vehicle_model/hotlist_us_state keys. show() (~line 446 select, ~461-469 payload): identical expansion. Cache key (~scanner:day:{orgId}:{kitId}:{date} and scanner:trip): append a version suffix (:v2). Test: extend insertHitCold()/insertHitHot() to write the four columns; add assertions on hits_detail[0] for vehicle_year/make/model/hotlist_us_state and hit_type.

subtasks.approach: In DayOverlay.vue, replace the Teleport `fixed inset-0 z-50 ... bg-black/70` hit-lightbox (lines 242-283) with the already-imported BottomSheet component (same usage as the 'Route Overview' sheet at line 103: bottom-28/z-30 above the bottom-nav pill, drag handle, light backdrop). Wire BottomSheet open state off selectedHit (open when non-null, clear selectedHit on close). Apply the identical markup change to TripOverlay.vue (lines 156-197) to keep the two overlays in sync; confirm BottomSheet is imported there (add the import if missing).
